reserves.name: Apollo Crypto managed yield strategy NAV
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Midas Software GmbH (certificate issuer and obligor); ACM International Ltd is the investment manager of the notional reference portfolio, not the obligor.

reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies mAPOLLO as an Apollo Crypto managed-yield strategy NAV. The September 14 transparency view discloses dated asset and protocol positions, including material borrow liabilities. Its main-position table is rounded and excludes absolute deltas below $100,000; it is not a complete reconciled balance sheet. The existing NAV envelope therefore retains unresolved allocation rather than converting positive positions alone into reserve weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas mAPOLLO product, final-terms, and transparency disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Some assets and venues are disclosed, but complete signed positions, smaller residuals, token-backing scope and custody relationships remain unverified. The 100% unresolved envelope reflects the missing complete allocation, not a claim that no positions are published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Midas documents the token, deposit and redemption vaults and NAV data feed. The September 14 dashboard names protocols and signed positions, but does not establish a complete position-level custody inventory, provider shares, legal segregation or bankruptcy-remoteness terms. Material borrowing must remain in any reconciliation; attestation checkpoints do not replace custody look-through.
